scope: Actual registry/commitment/Hub/boundary owners with declared logical input, publication, readiness, foreign-cell and Core Work state fixtures. Prior-source failures are reproduced. No device delivery, full camera/InputSystem lifecycle, renderer, browser or human acceptance claim.

checks.name: previous pending request survives departure and incorrectly starts on a no-input return
leaving Hub retires owned pending intent; returning requires a fresh choice
previous queued choice can cross while Core Work is active
Core Work entry cancels queued travel without changing anatomy or credits
same-frame Core Work command wins over an unstarted queued destination
cancel clears the queued choice and cannot auto-resume after release
same-frame A plus Core Work cannot create a new route request
a started boundary claim remains authoritative before its first flight publication
normal completion clears the old request without duplicating entry on a later Hub return
pending cancellation never deletes a replacement request with another owner identity
a stale offered event emitted after departure is acknowledged rather than replayed
inspection alone and brief preparation loss preserve deliberate waiting as before
